label: Town Hall
brief: One-and-a-half-storey Classical Revival building of smooth buff limestone ashlar on a raised basement: a hipped slate roof with a central front gable holding a carved lunette, and an entrance pavilion with pilasters, entablature and a glazed double door up a short flight of steps. A lower flat-roofed stone wing with a garage door steps off one side, and a tall square stone chimney/stack rises at the rear. Flagpole and a small monument sign in the lawn; the town's spheroid water tower looms right behind.
